script:
cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\audit2"
"=== git ==="
git log --oneline -1
"=== venv ==="
if (!(Test-Path .venv)) { "creating venv..."; py -m venv .venv } else { "venv exists" }
"=== deps ==="
& .\.venv\Scripts\Activate.ps1
pip install -q -r requirements.txt 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 2
python -c "import insightface, onnxruntime, cv2; print('deps ok')"
"=== models ==="
Test-Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.insightface\models\buffalo_l"
"=== metric check ==="
Select-String -Path tests/test_config.yaml -Pattern "pixel_flat_threshold"
